Topic 2.2.2: Safe and

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Safe and. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify dangerous places in the community
2. keep personal safety in the community
3. respond appropriately to security threats in the community. guardians about dangerous places in the community and report back.
